rules.description: File must have a default export with title and component fields
Stories must be typed as StoryObj<typeof ComponentName>
At least one named story export (Default, Primary, etc.)
Story or meta must include parameters.a11y configuration
Each named story must define args or inherit from meta.args
Meta should include tags: ['autodocs'] for auto-generated docs
Story args should use realistic values, not 'string' or 'text'
